svg.title: Grasshopper G_Code Generation
svg.desc: Dark mode continuous flow architecture diagram for Grasshopper G_Code Generation, showing detailed connected stages from Rhino and Grasshopper inputs through geometry extraction, reconstruction, topology, toolpath graph, validation, clay and SCARA models, motion scheduling, firmware postprocessing, preview, and G-code export.
svg.text: Continuous dark-mode manufacturing flow: Rhino/GH geometry becomes validated, clay-aware, SCARA-aware machine motion before G-code is emitted.
Rule: do not discover manufacturability in G-code. Validate geometry, process, motion, and machine constraints first.
Continuity split at G0, G1, G2 breaks
Arc fitting where firmware supports it
Events: start, stop, dwell, pressure relief
Drying window and material batch data
Path distortion and nozzle orientation risk
CC Curve Toolpath, CC Surface Toolpath
CC Build Graph, CC Validate Toolpath
CC Clay Profile, CC Machine Profile
CC SCARA Validate, CC Motion Schedule
CC Postprocess GCode, CC Preview, CC Export
The cyan path is the primary manufacturing pipeline. Every stage creates typed artifacts for the next stage.
Yellow dashed lines preserve source traceability and relationship metadata through the Manufacturing Knowledge Graph.
Red dashed lines mean validation can force recompute, user edits, route changes, or geometry/process changes before export.
ManufacturingSession contains profiles, source references, canonical paths, topology maps, toolpath graph, knowledge graph,
validation reports, clay process state, machine validation results, motion program, G-code program, and preview scene.
Grasshopper remains the UI layer. The engine owns the durable manufacturing model.
Implementation phases embedded in the flow
Phase 1: curve-native engine and basic validation. Phase 2: graph routing. Phase 3: surface/non-planar paths.
Phase 4: mesh/Brep adapters. Phase 5: clay, motion, SCARA validation. Phase 6: profiles, tests, docs, firmware coverage.
Each phase should add capability without changing the core typed artifact flow.
